sections.title: Introduction

quiz.question: What is the difference between except Exception and bare except?
options: Manages a dynamic number of context managers. Essential when you don't know how many resources you need at write time.
Pydantic validates data using Python type hints. It provides: automatic type coercion, rich validation errors, JSON serialization, and settings management.
Factory creates different types of objects through a single interface (which type).
except Exception catches all exceptions except SystemExit, KeyboardInterrupt, GeneratorExit.
quiz.explanation: except Exception catches all exceptions except SystemExit, KeyboardInterrupt, GeneratorExit. Bare except: catches everything including those. Always use except Exception — never bare except.

quiz.question: When does the else block execute in try/except/else/finally?
options: dump() writes to a file. dumps() returns a string. Similarly, load() reads from file, loads() parses a string.
DIP is the principle (depend on abstractions). DI is the technique (pass dependencies from outside).
__exit__ is still called with the exception info (exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb).
else runs only if NO exception occurred in the try block. finally ALWAYS runs regardless.
quiz.explanation: else runs only if NO exception occurred in the try block. finally ALWAYS runs regardless.

quiz.question: What is exception chaining (raise ... from ...)?
options: Reusable setup/teardown functions. Fixtures provide test data, configure test environments, and manage resources.
High-level file operations: copy2() (copy with metadata), copytree() (copy directories), move(), rmtree() (delete directory tree), make_archive() (create zip/tar).
Rotates log files when they reach a size limit. maxBytes sets file size limit, backupCount keeps N backup files.
Links a new exception to the original cause. raise NewError("msg") from original_error.
quiz.explanation: Links a new exception to the original cause. raise NewError("msg") from original_error. The __cause__ attribute preserves the chain for debugging.

quiz.question: Why create custom exception classes?
options: Generators produce values one at a time (lazy evaluation) instead of storing all values in memory.
Creates a logger named after the module (e.g., myapp.utils.db).
Python uses Protocols (structural typing). Small, focused protocols let classes implement only what they need.
Custom exceptions make errors semantic and catchable.
quiz.explanation: Custom exceptions make errors semantic and catchable. Instead of generic ValueError, raise InvalidEmailError — it's self-documenting, can carry extra data, and callers can catch specific errors.

quiz.question: What are Exception Groups (Python 3.11+)?
options: Rotates log files when they reach a size limit. maxBytes sets file size limit, backupCount keeps N backup files.
@decorator passes the function directly. @decorator() calls decorator first (which returns the actual decorator).
Uses __aenter__ and __aexit__ (async methods). Used with async with for async resource management (DB connections, HTTP sessions).
ExceptionGroup bundles multiple exceptions together. except* handles specific types within the group.
quiz.explanation: ExceptionGroup bundles multiple exceptions together. except* handles specific types within the group. Useful for concurrent operations where multiple tasks can fail simultaneously.
